description: This file contains unit tests for the ConsulClusteringOptions class, verifying behaviors such as default creation, exception handling, client injection, and configuration setup. It also includes a fake implementation of IConsulClient to facilitate testing.

_classes.name: ConsulClusteringOptionsTests
_classes.description: Unit test class for ConsulClusteringOptions functionalities.

_classes.name: FakeConsul
_classes.description: Fake implementation of IConsulClient used for testing purposes.

methods.name: DefaultCreationBehaviorIsRetained
methods.description: Verifies that the default CreateClient property of ConsulClusteringOptions is not null after instantiation.

methods.name: ThrowsArgumentNullExceptionIfCallbackIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that passing a null callback to ConfigureConsulClient throws ArgumentNullException.

methods.name: WeCanInjectAConsulClient
methods.description: Tests the ability to inject a custom IConsulClient implementation and retrieve it via CreateClient.

methods.name: WeCanUseConfigureToSetupTheDefaultClient
methods.description: Checks that configuring the client with address and token sets up the client correctly.

methods.name: WeCanUseConfigureToSetupTheDefaultClientWithoutAAclToken
methods.description: Verifies configuration without specifying an ACL token.
